full_text:
Article 3 (Application for Legal Representation)
(1) Applications for legal representation as defined in Article 9(1) of the Act must be submitted using Form 2 (attached). In this case, when an attorney submits the application, they must also include a power of attorney and copies of the applicant's and attorney's identification documents.
(2) Regarding the evidence gathering and other procedures related to the application under Article 1(1), Article 2(2) shall be applied.
